Privacy

Your records deserve a clear explanation.

Here is how information moves through the planning experience.

Device drafts

The degree builder stores your draft, original learning records, notes, and per-program choices in your browser’s local storage. A device draft does not automatically become a public community post or an account copy. Other people using the same browser profile may be able to access the device draft.

You can export a private backup. Keep it somewhere appropriate for your personal records. Clearing browser data may remove the local copy.

Optional account saving

Account saving sends a private copy of the selected draft to DegreeSteps’s hosted database only after you choose to save it and consent to the upload. That copy can contain learning records, placements, and private notes. Saved plans are scoped to the signed-in account.

Email and Google sign-in use a managed authentication provider. Password handling and recovery use that provider. Device-only planning remains available without an account.

The account tools provide controls to manage saved plans and remove portal data. Signing out does not automatically erase a device draft; use the device-copy controls when using a shared computer.

Transcript and spreadsheet imports

Text-based transcript PDFs, Excel files, and CSV files are read in your browser. You review the extracted course rows before adding them to your device draft. This local import does not upload your file or automatically create an account copy.

For a scan or a layout that needs extra help, you can choose the optional AI reader. After you sign in and explicitly consent, the selected document pages are sent as images to DegreeSteps’ server and Anthropic for extraction. DegreeSteps does not store the raw document, page images, or extraction response. Limited account and request-timing metadata is retained to enforce usage limits. Anthropic’s handling of submitted data is governed by its own terms and privacy practices.

After you review and add courses, those course records stay in your browser until you choose to back up a private account copy. You can also enter a course manually.

Public community contributions

Browsing community resources is public. Publishing posts, comments, reactions, and outcome reports requires sign-in. The public alias and text you submit can be visible to other visitors. A proposed plan preview omits private completed and in-progress learning records and private notes.

Review every public preview. Do not publish student identifiers, full transcripts, sensitive documents, or another person’s private information. Proof links for community outcomes must be suitable for public viewing and appropriately redacted.

Aggregate website measurement

We count a small set of daily events to understand whether visitors reach useful plans and actions. These aggregate counts do not contain account identifiers, tracking cookies, IP addresses, transcripts, course records, profile contents, query strings or referrer URLs. Counts are retained for up to 90 days. They are activity counts, not individual student histories.

You can turn this measurement off on this device. We also respect browser Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control preferences.

Degree coach questions

When the beta degree coach is available, your question is sent to DegreeSteps’s server and Anthropic to write a short answer from our researched plans. Questions are saved without your name to improve DegreeSteps: we keep the question with emails, phone numbers, long numbers and link parameters removed, its topics, the searches the coach ran and the plans it found, a shortened copy of the answer, its cost, and any rating you give. These records are deleted after 180 days. We do not store IP addresses; a one-way daily code is kept briefly to apply the daily question limit. Your saved courses are sent only when you tick the box for that question, as course titles, providers, credits and your chosen plan, and that summary is not stored. Don’t include personal details in a question.

Email alerts

If you turn on email alerts for a plan saved to your account, we keep your account email address, which saved plan the alert is for, the public DegreeSteps plan it follows, a short summary of that public plan (credits, cost range and school-confirmation status) and when we last emailed you. We use them only to email you when that plan’s requirements, costs or school confirmations change (at most once a week for each plan) and to send at most one saved-plan reminder a month. We never use this address for advertising and never share it with schools or course providers. Emails are sent through our email provider, Resend, which receives your email address and the message. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe link, and you can remove alerts in your account settings. Unsubscribing, deleting that saved plan or deleting your portal data removes the alert record. Unsubscribe links are stored only as one-way codes, and we count alert sign-ups and unsubscribes only as anonymous daily totals.

Cookies and service infrastructure

Hosting and connected authentication use the information needed to serve requests and maintain secure sessions. Account sessions use cookies. Provider sign-in pages and external resources have their own privacy practices. This site does not claim that external providers follow DegreeSteps’s practices.

Your choices

You can use public resources and build a local draft without publishing a plan. You can decline optional account uploads, review public previews before posting, export a private backup, and use account controls to remove saved portal information.

For questions about public community material, use its reporting controls. Avoid including private academic records in a public question.
